description: This script configures Wi-Fi interfaces, manages hostapd processes, updates network configurations, and starts services like dnsmasq and lighttpd for router setup and bridge mode configuration.

methods.name: Restart_Hostapd
methods.description: Restarts the hostapd service on the 2.4GHz interface.

methods.name: Restart_Hostapd_5G
methods.description: Restarts the hostapd service on the 5GHz interface, including module reloading.

methods.name: Hostapd_Restart
methods.description: Kills existing hostapd processes and restarts the 2.4GHz hostapd service.
